children: Ingram Micro reaffirmed Q3 FY2026 guidance and unveiled a multi-year framework targeting profitable growth and strong cash generation.
Introduced FY2026–2029 targets: net sales CAGR ~4–6% and gross profit CAGR ~5–7%, signaling gradual top-line and margin expansion.
Targets operating expenses at ~4.4–4.8% of net sales to drive operating leverage and higher-quality earnings.
Non-GAAP net income projected to grow ~11–13% CAGR, more than double net sales growth at framework midpoint.
Aims for adjusted free cash flow / adjusted EBITDA of ~30%+ annually and adjusted ROIC (four-year avg) of ~16–17%.
Capital Markets Day highlighted Xvantage platform, AI-driven capabilities and reach to >165,000 customers and 1,500+ vendors.
